description: The dge and decision-feedback roots through main() on a labelled disposable PostgreSQL (one fresh schema, no mask) over a fixture git repository with one pinned commit and a fixed path: dge register of a valid packet whose source is a regular blob at base, the same register again (cached) and status; dge register of a source digest mismatch and submit of an invalid event (M7's refusal shapes); decision-feedback status, report on an empty store, collect against the fixture registry at the pinned revision, report after it, and collect of a registry path that is not in the commit (M7's refusal); stdout, stderr and exit code per case
